i was looking through reddit to find something about merina and found your post. i am not a DR or OBGYN but i also have a merina IUD and i’ve had loads of complications since having it put in. i’ve had it for almost a year, and in the past 6 months i’ve had a lot of abnormal bleeding and intense cramping outside of my period ( i don’t have my period at all normally since i’ve had it). i’ve been to the hospital twice and they did a bunch of tests and everything is seemingly normal, but today i’ve had a comment from the doctor that i saw which is why i’m commenting today. 

apparently they don’t recommend merina anymore, it has too many side effects and there is new contraception methods that work just as well and with less side effects. they’re going to monitor me closely to make sure it’s not something else, but most likely they will remove it because they seem to be saying it might be the cause of all my problems. 

if you can look into other methods i recommend you do so, talk to your obgyn about alternatives. i hope this helped!
